mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wages and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month indicates a strong supply-side response to demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it indicates strong job growth, which is a positive signal for consumer spending and economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a quarter signals a strong demand environment, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease and HOUST increase > 5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
